title: 三方合并：非重叠区域自动合并（正例）
expected_output:
=== base -> ours 的行级 diff（LCS 对齐）===
  replace  base[0:1] -> ['timeout = 60']
  insert   base[5:5] -> ['pool_size = 8']

=== base -> theirs 的行级 diff（LCS 对齐）===
  replace  base[2:4] -> ['mode = fast', 'log_level = debug']

=== 合并结果（双方改动的区域不重叠 => 自动合并）===
  timeout = 60
  retries = 3
  mode = fast
  log_level = debug
  cache = off
  pool_size = 8

  冲突数: 0
  自动合并成功: True
  base 有 5 行，ours 改 2 处，theirs 改 1 处，结果 6 行
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""三方合并(three-way merge)：以 merge-base 为基线，分别把 ours / theirs 相对 base 的
改动切成 hunk（用 LCS 做行级 diff），把互不冲突的 hunk 落到同一个结果里。

注意它是『三方』而不是『两方』：只有知道 base 才能区分
「A 新加的行」和「A 本来就有的、被 B 删掉的行」。"""
import difflib

BASE = [
    "timeout = 30",
    "retries = 3",
    "mode = safe",
    "log_level = warn",
    "cache = off",
]
OURS = [
    "timeout = 60",        # 改动第 1 行（区域 1）
    "retries = 3",
    "mode = safe",
    "log_level = warn",
    "cache = off",
    "pool_size = 8",       # 尾部新增（区域 2）
]
THEIRS = [
    "timeout = 30",
    "retries = 3",
    "mode = fast",         # 改动第 3 行（区域 3）
    "log_level = debug",   # 改动第 4 行（区域 3）
    "cache = off",
]


def hunks(base, side):
    """返回 [(base_start, base_end, replacement_lines)]，只保留非 equal 的 opcode。"""
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=base, b=side, autojunk=False)
    out = []
    for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
        if tag != "equal":
            out.append((i1, i2, side[j1:j2]))
    return out


def merge3(base, ours, theirs):
    """合并两侧改动：非重叠区域各自采纳，重叠且不一致 -> 冲突。"""
    h = [("ours",) + x for x in hunks(base, ours)] + [("theirs",) + x for x in hunks(base, theirs)]
    h.sort(key=lambda t: (t[1], t[2]))
    out, pos, i, conflicts = [], 0, 0, 0
    while i < len(h):
        j = i
        cluster_end = h[i][2]
        while j + 1 < len(h) and h[j + 1][1] <= cluster_end:
            j += 1
            cluster_end = max(cluster_end, h[j][2])
        cluster = h[i:j + 1]
        out.extend(base[pos:min(cluster[0][1], len(base))])
        o = [c for c in cluster if c[0] == "ours"]
        t = [c for c in cluster if c[0] == "theirs"]
        if o and t:
            same = sorted(x[3] for x in o) == sorted(x[3] for x in t)
            if same:
                for x in o:
                    out.extend(x[3])
            else:
                conflicts += 1
                out.append("<<<<<<< HEAD")
                for x in o:
                    out.extend(x[3])
                out.append("=======")
                for x in t:
                    out.extend(x[3])
                out.append(">>>>>>> theirs")
        elif o:
            for x in o:
                out.extend(x[3])
        else:
            for x in t:
                out.extend(x[3])
        pos = max(pos, cluster_end)
        i = j + 1
    out.extend(base[pos:])
    return out, conflicts


print("=== base -> ours 的行级 diff（LCS 对齐）===")
for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=BASE, b=OURS, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if tag != "equal":
        print("  %-8s base[%d:%d] -> %s" % (tag, i1, i2, OURS[j1:j2]))
print()
print("=== base -> theirs 的行级 diff（LCS 对齐）===")
for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=BASE, b=THEIRS, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if tag != "equal":
        print("  %-8s base[%d:%d] -> %s" % (tag, i1, i2, THEIRS[j1:j2]))
print()
merged, conflicts = merge3(BASE, OURS, THEIRS)
print("=== 合并结果（双方改动的区域不重叠 => 自动合并）===")
for line in merged:
    print("  " + line)
print()
print("  冲突数: %d" % conflicts)
print("  自动合并成功: %s" % (conflicts == 0))
print("  base 有 %d 行，ours 改 %d 处，theirs 改 %d 处，结果 %d 行"
      % (len(BASE), len(hunks(BASE, OURS)), len(hunks(BASE, THEIRS)), len(merged)))
